simple.summary: אַחַר (ʼachar) means after First listed occurrence: Dan 2 29.

definitions.full: H311. achar [ אחר ] plural with אַחֲרֵי , preposition after (Cappadocian and Egyptian Aramaic אחר afterwards (Lzb Eph.i. 361 S-C pap C 8 ), probably Nabataean אחר after (Lzb 212 SAC 16 ); Egyptian Aramaic אחריכם (S-C Pap. c 8 +); ᵑ7 (sometimes) אֲחוֺרֵי ; Biblical Hebrew אַחַר ); — דְנָה אַחֲרֵי after this Dan 2:29 , 45 ; with suffix אַחֲרֵיהֹן 7:24 . Usu. Aramaic synonym בָּאתַר , q. v.
